question.text: What will be the result of the Singapore vs Paraguay match at the Mizuho Blue Challenge on 13 November 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves according to the result of the Singapore vs Paraguay match at the Mizuho Blue Challenge, scheduled to kick off at 20:00 SGT (12:00 UTC) on 13 November 2026 at the Singapore National Stadium, as shown on the ESPN match page https://www.espn.com/soccer/match/_/gameId/401916338/paraguay-singapore. If that page records Paraguay with more goals than Singapore at full time, the answer is "Paraguay win"; if the two teams' goal totals are equal, "Draw"; if Singapore has more goals, "Singapore win". Full time means the end of 90 minutes plus stoppage time; a post-match penalty shootout, if one is held, does not affect the result.
question.fine_print: If the match is cancelled, abandoned, or postponed and is not completed on 13 November 2026 (local Singapore time) so that no final result is recorded, the question is annulled. If the ESPN match page is unavailable or shows no result, the result at full time according to [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) will be used.
